note: P4388 (Pro 31:11) — the heart of her husband trusts in her; he has no lack of gain.

dims.v: reliability — the wife her husband's heart safely trusts
the trustworthiness of the wife in whom her husband's heart can safely trust, so that he lacks no gain — the reliability and faithfulness that makes her a partner he can rest his confidence in wholly
(the husband's trusting heart that rests on her)
the dependable faithfulness that earns a husband's full confidence

batach (trust) — 'the heart of her husband TRUSTS in her, and he will have no lack of gain' (31:11); her trustworthiness is such that her husband confides in her without reserve. Reliability of character is the foundation of the marriage's prosperity and peace.
